items.text: New York is without RB Breece Hall, WR Adonai Mitchell, EDGE Joseph Ossai and G Dylan Parham.
New England is without CBs Carlton Davis III and Karon Prunty; WR A.J. Brown was activated from IR and is questionable, RB TreVeyon Henderson questionable after full practices.
Saturday: New England CB Christian Gonzalez is back after missing two games; A.J. Brown is expected to be activated, a game-time decision. Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. is expected to play.
